# Isolated preview libraries

- Anime.js 4.5.0: copied from the existing repository dependency through the V3 documentation vendor copy; MIT license retained. https://animejs.com/ and https://github.com/juliangarnier/anime
- Lenis 1.3.27: downloaded from the versioned npm distribution at https://unpkg.com/lenis@1.3.27/dist/lenis.mjs and https://unpkg.com/lenis@1.3.27/dist/lenis.css. License: https://unpkg.com/lenis@1.3.27/LICENSE. Official release: https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis/releases/tag/v1.3.27

Retrieved 14 November 2026. These local copies support documentation previews only. No package manifest or application dependency was changed.

Google Material Icons **chevron_right**: original SVG retained as `chevron-right.svg`; its path is inlined with currentColor in the console study. Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/blob/master/src/navigation/chevron_right/materialicons/24px.svg. Apache 2.0 license retained in `LICENSE-material-icons.txt`. Retrieved 14 November 2026.
